question: Do Longer Prompts Give Better Results?
answer: Not always. A longer prompt gives the AI more information, but it also gives it more things to get wrong. Use enough detail to explain what you want. Don’t add details just to make the prompt longer.

question: Should I Use JSON or Normal Prompts?
answer: It depends on the generator. In testing, Vivid 1 and Vivid 2 worked very well with detailed JSON prompts. The default Dreamy generator was much less accurate with them and gave better results with normal paragraph prompts. JSON is not always better — test both with the generator you are using.

question: Why Is OurDream Not Following My Prompt?
answer: Your prompt may be too vague, you may be asking for too many things at once, or some of your instructions may conflict with each other. It can also be the generator. If the prompt looks good but the result keeps failing, try another generator or rewrite the same instructions in a different format.

question: Should I Use the Same Prompt for Every OurDream Generator?
answer: No. Different generators can respond differently to the same prompt. A prompt that works perfectly with Vivid 2 may not work as well with Dreamy. Always test the prompt with the generator you actually plan to use.

question: What Should I Do If My Image Is Almost Perfect?
answer: Change only the part that is wrong. If the outfit, background, and lighting are good but the hand position is wrong, only change the hand instruction. If you rewrite everything, you may fix the hand but accidentally ruin everything else.

question: Should I Put Outfits and Locations in My Character Prompt?
answer: Usually not if they are temporary. Things like eye color, hair, or other permanent features make sense in a character prompt. An outfit, location, or situation can change, so those details are usually better added when creating the image or starting the scene.

question: Do I Need to Know Prompt Engineering to Use OurDream AI?
answer: No. You can get good results with very simple prompts. Prompting becomes more useful when you want more control over small details. You can also use ChatGPT to help turn a simple idea into a more detailed prompt.

question: What Is the Biggest Prompting Mistake Beginners Make?
answer: Trying to make the perfect prompt before generating anything. Start with what you know you want, generate, look at the result, and then improve it. That is usually much faster than spending ten minutes trying to write one massive prompt before you even know what the AI will get wrong.
